changelog.note: Moved the CapCut bridge to its own port (9011) so it never clashes with other CapCut tools on the same computer. Run the update once; nothing else changes.

First release. Claude builds CapCut projects with your clips, photos, text and music, saves them straight into CapCut under the name you pick (never replacing a project you made), makes free transcripts and captions files on your computer, and moves finished videos into your project folder.
